_about: Mission clear-condition filters: the server-side table the client never had, rebuilt by hand. Keyed by EntityMMission.MissionClearConditionOptionGroupId, or by missionId for a mission that shares an option group but counts something else (a mission entry wins). A mission whose option group is not listed here never progresses.
